policy: Exact public/ad-hoc tariff evidence only. Subscription, roaming, historical and sampled station values are not generalized beyond their proven scope.

findings.publicNetwork: SWM states it operates about 1,400 publicly accessible charging points in the Munich area.
findings.directPayment: Official SWM pages confirm spontaneous direct payment by QR code / credit card at supported SWM stations and describe ad-hoc charging separately from the SWM charging-card tariffs.
findings.currentTariffContext: From 2026-07-01 SWM says charging cost depends on the selected tariff. The published Flex charging-card tariff has 0 EUR/month base fee and own-network prices of 0.49 EUR/kWh AC and 0.69 EUR/kWh DC/HPC, but it still requires the SWM charging-card product and a one-time card fee. The official ad-hoc/direct-payment flow does not expose a numeric current price in the public documentation audited here.
findings.blocking: SWM states no blocking fee applies at SWM stations when using the SWM charging card; this does not prove the same condition for ad-hoc credit-card sessions.

cpos.reason: Current direct-payment access is official, but the numeric post-2026-07-01 ad-hoc price is not publicly tied to that contract-free payment flow. The zero-monthly-fee Flex card tariff must not be substituted for ad-hoc without checkout evidence.
cpos.neededToComplete: Resolve an SWM QR/direct-payment checkout for representative AC and DC/HPC EVSEs or an official station tariff feed, then prove whether direct payment matches a published SWM tariff and whether any ad-hoc blocking/payment fee applies.

findings.publicNetwork: SachsenEnergie states that its own network comprises more than 1,700 charging points in Dresden and eastern Saxony.
findings.directPayment: The official StromTanken App page explicitly documents charging without a contract and without a monthly base fee, including QR/station selection and payment-method selection.
findings.energyPrice: For charging without a contract at SachsenEnergie-owned charging stations, the official current table publishes 0.50 EUR/kWh for both AC and DC.
findings.blocking: The same table gives the contract product a 0 EUR blocking fee, while the without-contract column says blocking fee equals the price of the respective charge-point operator. It does not separately state a numeric SachsenEnergie-owned ad-hoc blocking fee.

cpos.reason: The exact ad-hoc energy component is official and current at 0.50 EUR/kWh AC/DC on SachsenEnergie stations, but the direct-payment blocking/time component is not numerically resolved. Exact total session pricing therefore remains incomplete.
cpos.neededToComplete: Resolve a SachsenEnergie-owned station checkout/QR payload or another official tariff document that explicitly states the blocking/time fee for without-contract sessions (including confirmation if it is zero), then attach the 0.50 EUR/kWh rule only to validated SachsenEnergie EVSEs.

cpos.operator: swb AG / swb Vertrieb Bremen GmbH

findings.publicNetwork: swb states it operates around 80 publicly accessible charging locations with more than 150 charging points in Bremen, Bremerhaven and the region.
findings.publishedOwnNetworkTariff: The current official Mobilstromkarte product publishes 0.47 EUR/kWh AC and 0.57 EUR/kWh DC at swb and ladenetz partner points, with monthly contract/card base fees. A 0.10 EUR/min usage fee can apply from minute 241 AC or 121 DC during 08:00-20:00 under the card product.
findings.directPaymentEvidence: The public swb pages audited here focus on RFID/ladenetz access and do not expose a current numeric contract-free QR/card checkout tariff for the swb public network.

cpos.reason: The available numeric pricing is explicitly tied to the swb Mobilstromkarte contract. It cannot be generalized as the CPO's ad-hoc tariff without a direct-payment source.
cpos.neededToComplete: Resolve an official/public ad-hoc payment surface for swb-operated EVSEs (QR/card checkout, ladenetz direct-payment payload, AFIR/Mobilithek tariff feed or equivalent) and map exact energy/time pricing to the affected stations.
